limits Every limit below is copied from the manufacturer's manual or spec page, with the link, and the date we read it. Models we could not source are left out. Model Air fry max Preheat Source Cosori Pro LE 5.0-Quart Basket · 5 qt / 4.7 L 450°F / 230°C Built-in step Manual 2026-10-28 Cosori TurboBlaze 6.0-Quart Basket · 6 qt / 5.7 L 450°F / 230°C Built-in step Manual 2026-10-28 Cosori Stainless Steel 6.5-Quart Smart Basket · 6.5 qt / 6.2 L 450°F / 230°C Manual Manual 2026-10-28 Cosori Lite 2.1-Quart Mini Basket · 2.1 qt / 2 L 400°F / 205°C Not stated Manual 2026-10-28 Cosori TwinFry 9.0-Quart Dual-zone · 9 qt / 8.5 L 400°F / 205°C Broil to 465°F Not stated Manual 2026-10-28 Cosori 9.0-Quart Dual Basket Dual-zone · 9 qt / 8.5 L 450°F / 230°C Built-in step Manual 2026-10-28 Cosori 13-Quart Air Fryer Oven Toaster-oven combo · 13 qt / 12.3 L 450°F / 230°C Built-in step Manual 2026-10-28 Max temperature of every sourced model → Built-in programs on the Cosori TurboBlaze 6.0-Quart The program table from the manual: the default each button starts at, and how far you can move it. Program Starts at Range Air Fry 385°F 300–450°F Roast 425°F 350–450°F Broil 450°F 425–450°F Frozen 390°F 300–450°F Reheat 390°F 300–425°F Bake 330°F 260–400°F Dehydrate 135°F 100–200°F Proof 90°F 90–110°F Why a 450°F basket changes the answer Take an oven recipe at 475°F for 15 minutes, such as oven fries. A converter built around a 400°F basket gives 400°F for 12 minutes: it cannot go hotter, so it adds time to make up the heat. On a TurboBlaze the same recipe converts to 450°F for 11 minutes, because the basket can actually reach the converted temperature. Check from minute 8. The difference matters most for fries, wings and anything you want browned fast. Following the longer generic time at the higher Cosori temperature dries the inside out before the timer ends. Cosori programs are not the same as a recipe temperature Cosori's buttons start at their own defaults, and those defaults are often lower than the maximum. On the TurboBlaze, Air Fry starts at 385°F and goes up to 450°F, Bake tops out at 400°F, and Reheat at 425°F. If a converted setting is above what a program allows, use Air Fry and set the temperature by hand; the program will not accept it. Models with a Preheat button run it as its own step before cooking. The Lite mini has none, so add a minute or two to the first batch or let it run empty briefly. Dual baskets and the oven The TwinFry air fries to 400°F; only its Broil goes to 465°F, and the converter never uses Broil for a converted recipe. The 13-quart oven runs as an oven-style unit: a larger cavity with racks, so it gets the gentler oven-style conversion. Related Homemade fries 380°F · 18 min · shake ×2 Chicken wings 400°F · 22 min · flip at 11 Frozen pizza 380°F · 9 min Oven to air fryer converter → Ninja air fryer conversion → Philips Airfryer conversion → Instant Vortex air fryer conversion → Frequently asked questions What is the maximum temperature on a Cosori air fryer? It depends on the model. The Cosori models in our table air fry up to 450°F, and the Lite mini and TwinFry stop at 400°F. The table on this page lists each one with a link to its manual. Should I use the Cosori preset buttons for oven recipes? Use Air Fry and set the converted temperature and time yourself. Each preset starts at its own default and some cap lower than Air Fry, so a preset can quietly give you a cooler setting than the recipe needs. Do I need to preheat a Cosori? Models with a Preheat button run it as a separate step, and the manual recommends it. Models without one simply start cooking, so the first batch can take slightly longer. Why is the Cosori time shorter than other converters give? Because the basket can reach the hotter setting. Converters that assume a lower ceiling add time to make up for the missing heat; on a model that reaches the temperature, that extra time overcooks. Does the TwinFry get the same higher limit? No. Its manual lists Air Fry up to 400°F. Only Broil goes higher, and broiling is not a substitute for converting an oven recipe.
